paragraphs: A full-stack website for a local, brick-and-mortar specialty vape shop: a public product catalog plus a private admin CMS for the shop owner to manage it. It is catalog-only by design — no cart, no checkout, no live inventory. Every product page says "Available in store — contact us for current availability", and prices are intentionally never shown publicly.
features: Instant product browsing — the /products page fetches the whole catalog once on the server (SSR, so the first paint is fast and crawlable), then filters by category, brand and free-text search entirely in the browser.…

Flexible per-category product attributes — a disposable has puff count and nicotine strength, an e-liquid has VG/PG ratio, a device has battery and output modes. Instead of one rigid schema, attributes live in a…
Admin CMS gated by Google sign-in — Auth.js v5 with an email allowlist (ALLOWEDADMINEMAILS). Anyone else who signs in with Google is rejected.
Manual ordering with priority — an optional integer per product (lower = first, blank = last). The homepage shows the top 8 by priority, and every product listing uses the same ordering.
Age verification gate — a non-dismissable 19+ modal shown once per browser session on the public site.
